'''Stacy Mollema''' worked in Lucasfilm licensing. Her name is the unscrambling of the anagram [[Leslomy Tacema]].<ref name="ana">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (geocities.ws/plarathas). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012174750/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Internet Archive]. Mirrors: [https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html oocities.org] (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive]); reocities (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160406045459/http://www.reocities.com/CollegePark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive])</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], Players Committee, p. 200. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

The credits page of the [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] rules booklet (1995) thanks [[Julia Russo]] and Stacy Mollema "for every concept, word, line, punctuation mark and frame you efficiently reviewed and approved from the four corners of the globe (and every ounce of encouragement along the way)".<ref name="2p-credits">[https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Introductory Two-Player Game Rules Booklet], Decipher / Parker Brothers (1995), credits page. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015192404/https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Internet Archive]</ref>
